My verdict is **PASS** on candidate `sha256:d8d83181…` (2203 files, source `54e02b6`), with no new finding. But the gate can't be approved yet: the repository at HEAD no longer matches the frozen candidate, and you need to fix that before the audit. **Action needed: the working tree has drifted from the frozen candidate (check QA-RG4-00b, FAIL).** - Commit `8fbdc7a` added the D-189 row to `docs/delivery/decisions.md` after the freeze. That file counts toward the candidate ID, so the working tree at HEAD now hashes to `ec9b3d94…` instead of `d8d83181…`. - `candidate.mjs --diff` exits 1 and lists only that file. `validate.mjs --reconcile` marks every DG5 review as stale. - This is the same problem the auditor blocked DG4 on before (D-136, B1). - I didn't raise it as a finding because findings must be owned by an implementer role, and this belongs to the orchestrator. - What I reviewed is exactly `d8d83181`, on a complete clone at `54e02b6`. No product, test or tooling file differs, so none of my judgements change. - Gate validation will keep failing until `decisions.md` in the working tree is back to its frozen content (sha256 `818f68c0…`). Re-freezing instead would make every DG5 review stale, including this one. **My two open findings (both Low, not mandatory): both accepted as observations and carried to DG6 as fixes.** | Finding | Judgement | Basis | |---|---|---| | F-DG5-145: p4-benefits test 8 runs on the default 30 s budget | ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION |
  • It's a test-budget problem only.
  • Run alone this round: 16.7 s (English) and 15.5 s (Arabic).
  • Under artificial CPU load (median 5.9): 23.7 s.
  • Round 3, full suite under load: 30.2 s, the timeout. No step took over 1.53 s.
  • Its assertions passed in every run, and a timeout always fails, never passes by mistake.
  • Its requirement, REQ-PB-075, is a DG4 row.
  • DG6 fix: an explicit budget with at least 2× headroom, or split the test, then check the other specs on the default budget.
| | F-DG5-146: the session-end test races My Work's paged load | ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION |
  • A new test that holds My Work's first load reproduces the race every time (4/4, English and Arabic).
  • The app itself lands once on sign-in with the translated message and returns to My Work afterwards, with no redirect loop.
  • If the test waits for the load to finish before signing out, the original assertions pass unchanged.
  • A race always fails, never passes by mistake.
  • Its requirement, REQ-S16-030, is a DG6 row.
  • DG6 fix: wait for the load before `signOutElsewhere()`.
  • Separately, My Work loads every page of open work items up front. That's DG4 behaviour, noted for DG6 performance work.
| **Other checks** - The candidate ID matched on the clone at the start and the end. - The historical validators for DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1, and the DG5 register check, all passed. - I didn't re-run the 78 requirements this round. They carry over from my round-3 PASS on the identical candidate, which the assignment permits. - No test this round failed, flaked, was skipped or timed out. Every warning and non-zero exit is explained in the run notes. - The task ID in the assignment's first line (`T-DG5-REV-QA-R5`) doesn't match the invocation (`T-DG5-RG-QA-R4`). This is cosmetic. - The disposable clone and all scratch files have been removed. Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-4/`: - qa-verifier.json - qa-verifier.verifications.json - qa-verifier.md Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-4/`, and the new test is `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-4/e2e/zz-qa-dg5rg4-session-race.spec.ts`.
